title:
Epic triggered on `STEP_INDEX_UPDATE` actions to validate selections for the
{@link ReliabilityMetric} creation forms. When a user makes
a selection for any of the following fields, the following validation occurs:

  - `name` - Checks that the name is unique for the given {@link ReliabilityMetric}.
            see {@link ReliabilityMetric#isNameDuplicated}. Also checks that the name
            is valid and not empty. A name is valid if it contains only alphanumeric
            characters and underscores.
  - `description` - Checks that the description is not empty.

If a field is invalid or empty, it will be highlighted, hint text will appear to indicate the
error, and the submission button will be disabled on the form.
If the name is duplicated, modal will appear to indicate the error.
name: ValidateReliabilityMetricSettingsEpic
